info.name: Bifrost MCP Harness
info.description: End-to-end MCP tests for Bifrost. Each folder inside a section is one test case, named by its ID, and its requests carry that ID as a prefix. Run with `make run-mcp-harness-test`, which boots its own Bifrost and enables dashboard auth before the run.
